limits: This is a software ELF reconstruction; it is not a full NAND dump with ECC or user filesystem recovery.
135 main-image LGLZ blocks, and prior eight native PXO blocks, are decoded. Other packaging is not exhaustively ruled out.

The original post-metadata branch starting VA0x065da146 runs with synthetic content metadata/stack and two zero-initialized BSS pages. Original string helpers and trampolines execute, but callback body is deliberately not executed.
This establishes actual dispatch to a player named GNEX, not a located/booted GNEX interpreter or SGS gameplay on this phone.
Outer ELF section-header fields are zero and remain unmodified. Original decoded960-byte section-name tail retained; no guessed section headers or padding.
Four overlapping scanner candidates in a monotone integer table are not accepted as recovered SGS.
Earlier naive 512+16 page strip and compressed-byte ELF xref reports are superseded; do not use them.
